title: Invitations
offer: We hold a feast here on the farm, for all our friends! Invite them: hail three boats on the lakes, and visit Tova and Ragnfrid.

says: A feast at your farm? We come, and bring our fiddle!
Count on me! I bring my best fish.
steps.say: A feast? Of course! I will tell everybody on the lakes.
I would not miss it! I come with my herb wine.
We come with all the horses! Silke wants to see her daughter.

fact: A great feast could last a week, with guests from every farm around.
